UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'ring-racers/7-Zip'; if (Test-Path '7z.exe') { exit 0 } else { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7z2600-x64.exe' -OutFile '7z-installer.exe' }; if ($?) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7zr.exe' -OutFile '7zr.exe' }; if ($?) { & ./7zr.exe x -y -aoa 7z-installer.exe *> $null 2>&1; Remove-Item -Path '7z-installer.exe' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'ring-racers/server'; $ServerVersion='{{ServerVersion}}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ServerVersion)) { $ServerVersion = (Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/KartKrewDev/RingRacers/releases/latest').tag_name }; if ($ServerVersion -notmatch '^v\d+\.\d+(-rc\d+)?$') { Write-Output \"Invalid server version format specified\"; exit 1 }; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://github.com/KartKrewDev/RingRacers/releases/download/$ServerVersion/Dr.Robotnik.s-Ring-Racers-$ServerVersion-Installer.exe -OutFile 'rrinstaller.exe'; & ../7-Zip/7z.exe x -y -aoa rrinstaller.exe | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Path 'rrinstaller.exe' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null"

-c "cd ring-racers/server && ServerVersion=\"{{ServerVersion}}\" && if [[ -z \"$ServerVersion\" ]]; then ServerVersion=$(wget -qO- https://api.github.com/repos/KartKrewDev/RingRacers/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name); fi && if [[ ! \"$ServerVersion\" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-rc[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid server version format specified\" && exit 1; fi && wget -qO rrinstaller.exe https://github.com/KartKrewDev/RingRacers/releases/download/$ServerVersion/Dr.Robotnik.s-Ring-Racers-$ServerVersion-Installer.exe && ../7-Zip/7zzs x -y -aoa rrinstaller.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f rrinstaller.exe >/dev/null 2>&1"
